phase: Phase 4 (change set 07): validate outcomes and expand only demonstrated gaps
frozen: 2026-10-18, before any outcome trial was run; later edits require a new protocol revision and must be reported beside results
scorer_only_rule: Scorer-only files never reach a condition's index, prompt or delivered text. Repair projects are materialized from evaluation/repairs/*/project only; the fixture directory itself is never captured.

t3.note: Held out from findings rule tuning since Phase 1; 14 scenarios in 12 families, 44 claims.

repairs.note: Authored for Phase 4 after the Phase 1-3 rules were frozen; no rule was tuned on them.

rg.description: Predeclared rg/read baseline (scripts/task_baseline.py protocol v3) over the source tree only.

rg+sessions.description: Same baseline with the raw session transcripts placed in the searched tree.

hybrid.description: Current hybrid retrieval without any findings producer (the pre-Phase-1 Case).

findings.description: Findings-enabled hybrid, source-only: behavior and convergence findings.

findings+sessions.description: Findings-enabled hybrid with imported session experience.

session_rule: Source-only and source-plus-session conditions are run and reported separately. In session comparisons the rg baseline searches the same transcripts (rg+sessions).

deterministic.description: No model. Reconstructs exactly the text each condition delivered under its budget and scores claim supportability: a claim is supportable when every witness (path+regex over delivered source text, or finding kind+regex over delivered findings) matches. Necessary, not sufficient, for a correct conclusion.
deterministic.repeat_purpose: Determinism check; any disagreement between repeats is reported as nondeterminism, not averaged away.

agent.description: Stochastic. An external agent command receives only the delivered context (and for repair fixtures a writable copy of the project) and returns claims with citations, a decision and a patch. Scored by citations, forbidden patterns, repair tests and edit scope.
agent.requires: explicit operator authorization (paid model calls); never run implicitly by tests or CI

metrics.claim_supportability: Share of scenario claims whose witnesses were all delivered (deterministic).
metrics.validated_repair: Agent patch applies, every target test passes, every neighbor and negative test passes (agent).
metrics.justified_decision: Agent decision equals the reference decision and cites at least one decision-witness path that the condition delivered (agent).
metrics.unnecessary_edits: Files changed by the agent patch outside the fixture's allowed_paths (agent).
metrics.unsupported_assertions: Agent claims without a citation, or citing a path the condition never delivered (agent).
metrics.unsupported_critical_claims: Deterministic: delivered findings that assert runtime satisfaction, executed verification, current session guidance, automatic change or adopted policy without basis (critical-claim audit). Agent: claims matching a scenario forbidden_pattern.
metrics.cost: calls, delivered bytes, wall seconds, files delivered.

statistics.unit: scenario (claims nested in scenarios; repeats nested in scenarios for the agent tier)
statistics.method: paired percentile bootstrap over scenarios, 10000 resamples, seed 20261018, 95% interval
statistics.uncertainty_reporting: Every contrast reports the mean paired difference, its 95% interval, the number of scenarios, and for the agent tier the per-scenario repeat spread.

exit_gate.rule: The primary contrast passes when its mean paired claim_supportability gain is at least 0.10 AND the 95% bootstrap interval's lower bound is above 0, under identical budgets, AND the treatment's unsupported_critical_claims do not exceed the control's (tolerance 0). Any other outcome is reported as 'not met' (interval includes or is below 0) or 'inconclusive' (point gain >= 0.10 but interval lower bound <= 0).
exit_gate.honesty: An inconclusive or negative result is reported as such; the protocol is not revised to rescue it.

failure_classes.selection: A witness path was in the candidate set but not delivered within budget.
failure_classes.discovery: A witness path never reached candidates.
failure_classes.producer: The witness path was delivered but the witnessed fact needs a relationship or finding no producer emits.
failure_classes.consumption: The witness text was within a delivered file but beyond the delivered byte range.

expansion_rule: TypeScript coverage, typed entities or behavioral relationships are expanded only where a classified producer failure demonstrates a missing producer or join; storage or index structures only where profiling shows a bottleneck.
